questions.stem: What is the key structural difference between amylose and amylopectin?

options.text: Amylose is branched while amylopectin is unbranched
Amylose is made from beta-glucose while amylopectin is made from alpha-glucose
Amylose is unbranched and helical while amylopectin is branched
Amylose is found in animals while amylopectin is found in plants

questions.explanation: Amylose is an unbranched chain of alpha-glucose that coils into a helix, while amylopectin is branched with 1,6 glycosidic bonds at branch points. Both are components of starch.
